title: Can't remove or Add Icons in Desktop

posts.name: MitexLeo
posts.cooked:
I’m unable to customize the desktop. After saving, if I refresh the page, All changes are gone.

image1841×1005 40.5 KB

{
	"frappe": "16.4.1",
	"erpnext": "16.3.0",
	"hrms": "16.2.0",
	"builder": "1.22.1"
}

posts.name: MitexLeo
posts.cooked:
The issue has been resolved after upgrading to:

{
“frappe”: “16.5.0”,
“erpnext”: “16.4.1”,
“hrms”: “16.3.1”,
“builder”: “1.22.3”
}
